notes.subject: klostu ... olgeta
notes.rationale: כמשלש 'olsem tripela' — 'klostu' bilong wanem Strong's i gat כ 'olsem/about'.

notes.subject: tripela mun
notes.rationale: Kaunim taim: klostu tripela mun bihain long Stat 38:20.

notes.subject: זנתה ... לזנונים
notes.rationale: Wanem as bilong sleep wantaim man i go moa — זנה lip long tupela ples long wanpela ves, Tok Pisin i tanim wankain 'pasin nogut' tupela taim, sanis i no daun.

translation: Na bihain, klostu tripela mun olgeta, ol i stori long Yehuda, i tok: Tamar, meri bilong pikinini man bilong yu, i slip wantaim man long pasin nogut, na lukim, em gat bel nau bilong pasin nogut. Na Yehuda i tok: Bringim em i kam aut, ol bai kukim em long paia.
